title: Coaching derivations: what each coaching aspect needs from telemetry, and what each game gives
notes: Three layers: channels (canonical quantities, units and conventions of oversteer/telemetry_formats.py Sample, plus derived basics and the rig inputs Oversteer reads itself), games (per game: how each channel is available, and static data from the game files), aspects (every coaching aspect: derivations in order of preference, gates, outputs, validation, implementation). A game channel not listed is resolved from the channel's derive_from alternatives, else absent. Statuses: confirmed (on a real capture), decoded (in code from published docs), derivable, absent. Static: shipped, in_game_files, planned, absent. Loader: oversteer/coaching_matrix.py; readable form: docs/coaching-derivations.md.

max_rpm.description: The limiter as the game reports it (ACR/ACC: physics currentMaxRpm).

car_name.description: The car as the game names it.

throttle.description: Throttle as the game sees it.

clutch.description: Clutch pedal pressed fraction (1 = pressed, drive disengaged).

track.description: Track or stage name as the game sends it.

brake.description: Brake as the game sees it.

stage.description: Stage key where the game identifies the stage or route.

car_class.description: The game's class of the car.

stage_length.description: Length of the stage or track (ACR: the road spline, longer than the published length).

running.description: False in menus or paused, where the game says.

handbrake.description: Handbrake as the game sees it.

steer.description: Steering input, normalised to the wheel lock.
steer.convention: positive left (ISO 8855); -1 full right, +1 full left

vel.convention: car frame x forward, y left, z up (ISO 8855)

accel.convention: car frame x forward, y left, z up; see accel_kind

accel_kind.description: 'kinematic' (the change of velocity, gravity not read at rest) or 'specific' (accelerometer).

yaw_rate.description: Angular velocity about the vertical axis.

wheel_speed.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

wheel_rot.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

slip_ratio.description: Longitudinal slip per wheel, as the game computes it (slip_kind says 'raw' or 'normalised', 1 = the grip limit).
slip_ratio.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

slip_angle.description: Tyre slip angle per wheel (Forza: normalised).
slip_angle.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

susp.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR; compression positive

susp_vel.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR; compressing positive

susp_norm.description: Suspension travel as a share of its range.
susp_norm.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

puddle.description: Wheel in a puddle (FH: 0/1, FM: depth).
puddle.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

rumble.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

surface_rumble.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

lap_distance.description: Position along the lap or stage (ACR: along the stage road spline).

progress.description: Share of the lap or stage done.

stage_time.description: The game's stage or race clock.

game_shift_rpm.description: Where the game's own shift lights end.

surface_grip.description: The game's grip level of the road (AC graphics surfaceGrip).

clock.description: Oversteer's receive clock (monotonic), on every packet.

a_vert.description: Vertical acceleration (kinematic: about -9.8 in free fall, 0 at rest).

body_slip.description: Body slip angle beta = atan2(vel.y, vel.x), above 5 m/s.
body_slip.convention: positive when the car moves to its left of where it points

curvature.description: Path curvature = yaw_rate / speed (or from positions).

grade.description: Road gradient: vertical over horizontal travel (vel.z / |vel|, or dy/ds of pos).

tyre_radius.description: Rolling radius per wheel: the game's where it sends one (AC, ACC), else speed / wheel_rot at low slip.
tyre_radius.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

slip_drive.description: Driven-wheel slip: driven wheel speed / road speed - 1 (shift_learner.drive_slip).

wheel_slip.description: Per-wheel longitudinal slip: wheel_speed / speed - 1 (negative: locking).
wheel_slip.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

pedal_rate.description: Rate of change of throttle and brake (smoothed).

run_distance.description: Distance along the run: the game stage distance, else speed integrated.

run_time.description: Time since the run started, on Oversteer's clock (ACR's result time).

airborne.description: All four wheels off the ground: suspension fully extended and free-fall vertical acceleration.

rig_throttle.description: Throttle pedal as Oversteer reads it from the wheel (gui.launch_inputs).

rig_clutch.description: Clutch pedal as Oversteer reads it from the wheel.

rig_handbrake.description: Handbrake axis as Oversteer reads it (the ANNX through the proxy).

shift_press.description: A gear-change input: 'gear' (H-pattern gate), 'sequential' or 'paddle', timestamped.

tyre_load.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

tyre_fx.description: Longitudinal force at each tyre, car frame (forward positive): the sum is m x a_x (r 0.97 to 0.99 on ACR).
tyre_fx.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

tyre_fy.description: Lateral force at each tyre, car frame (left positive): the sum is m x a_y (r 0.98 to 0.995 on ACR).
tyre_fy.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

tyre_slip.description: The game's own per-wheel slip (ACR wheelSlip: unnormalised, p95 0.2 to 1.8).
tyre_slip.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

combined_slip.description: Forza's combined tyre slip (1 is the limit).
combined_slip.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

tyre_temp.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

tyre_wear.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

tyre_pressure.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

brake_temp.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

susp_max.description: The suspension's full travel (what susp_norm divides by).
susp_max.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

hub_pos.description: Hub position relative to the body (EA SPORTS WRC).
hub_pos.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

hub_vel.convention: per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR

ang_vel.description: Angular velocity in the car frame: roll, pitch, yaw. Yaw is confirmed on ACR; the signs of the others wait for a capture.
ang_vel.convention: x forward, y left, z up

attitude.description: Yaw, pitch, roll of the body (Forza).

brake_bias.description: Share of the braking on the front axle.

transmission_speed.description: Speed of the transmission output (EA SPORTS WRC).

driving_line.description: Distance from the racing line, Forza (negative left).

ai_brake_diff.description: Forza's AI braking difference (the driving assist's brake advice).

gaps: No road edges: cutting, track use and line width cannot be judged, only compared with own runs (pos).
No grip figure from the game (surfaceGrip 0): grip is measured (g-g envelope) or taken from the stage table surface.
No stage clock: result times are Oversteer's own clock from the start to the last pace note.
No handbrake channel: the rig handbrake axis has to stand in (not wired into the trace yet).
No suspension range (suspensionMaxTravel empty): bottoming needs a learnt bump-stop travel.
No gear count in the packets: the top gear comes from the car data.
Position only since the 2026-09-27 bridge fix: older captures cannot place the car, so discipline by topology was unknown on them.
The full pace-note list is in the game files but not shipped (86e3faftn).
Tyre loads, forces and slip are decoded (Sample.tyre_load, tyre_fx, tyre_fy, tyre_slip) but not in the trace yet: per-wheel grip use waits for a trace format change.
No wheel speed in the trace: tyreRadius is 0; wheel_rot x the learnt or game radius gives it (launch spin, exit spin, lock-ups).

aspects.name: Discipline
aspects.description: What kind of driving the run is (rally stage, circuit, hillclimb, ...): gates most coaching.

derivations.formula: The game's own fields (EA session packets, DiRT laps, ACC session type) or a stage-table entry.
Loop closures of the position trace; none over 2 km: point to point.
A launch hold then one continuous 2-15 min run: a stage.

aspects.name: Surface
aspects.description: Tarmac, gravel, snow, ice or mixed, per run: slices every metric and gates shift and pedal advice.

derivations.formula: The stage table's surface for a known stage (game tier).
Per-segment features (g-g envelope, spin, roughness, slip-angle falloff) through a per-game calibrated classifier.

validation.evidence: replay of the 7 ACR captures (21 runs, 405 corners, 500 shifts), 2026-09-28: every ACR run got the table surface (Wales and Greece gravel, Alsace tarmac)

aspects.name: Grip level

aspects.name: Upshift timing against the lights band (per gear, per surface)
aspects.description: Flat-out changes up by one judged as a distribution against the band the game's shift lights give (the low end lowered where the gear is measured grip-limited, the high end the lights' late point or the limiter less a margin): shares early, on the band and on the limiter cut, and what the early and cut changes cost a stage.

derivations.formula: Best = the lowest rpm from which gear n+1's torque x ratio at the same road speed beats gear n's to the limiter (game torque curve and gearing); per surface, a gear whose measured full-throttle drive (wheelspin included, 20 samples from 3 pulls at least) stays under 0.8 of the engine's (against the higher gears) is grip-limited and its best drops to where n+1 reaches the same grip limit, anything from there to the engine's best on target. The game's data is set aside (learnt instead) where the learnt gearing is more than 4 % off its gear sets and wheelspin does not explain it. The crossover is the explanation of the drive lost, never the target: the band is the game's lights (shift to late, less the limiter margin: 150 rpm sequential, 300 H-pattern), or from the crossover where the game ships no lights. Each change is early (100 rpm below the band), on, late or cut (peak at 0.985 x the limiter or a limiter episode ended in it); cost = speed deficit over speed times the time to the next braking.
derivations.module: oversteer/shift_learner.py best_for, oversteer/coach_context.py shift_band, classify_shift, shift_costs

derivations.formula: Best from the learnt power per gear and band (acceleration x speed plus drag, slope taken out where the grade is known; crossover of P_n(rpm) with P_n+1(rpm x step)), with a bootstrap range; then the same per-surface grip check.

gates.surface: per surface; early changes on a loose or mixed surface only in 3rd and up where the gear is measured not grip-limited, never in 1st and 2nd, a note otherwise
gates.conditions: flat out (throttle >= 0.95 held), up by one gear, not the launch's change; a tip needs 5 changes and 0.2 s a stage

outputs.name: shift.in_band
outputs.note: on the lights band +-100 rpm, per gear and method

outputs.name: shift.early_share
outputs.note: below the band by 100 rpm or more

outputs.name: shift.cost
outputs.note: what the run's early and cut changes cost on the stage

validation.evidence: replay of the 7 ACR captures (21 runs, 405 corners, 500 shifts), 2026-09-28: 234 flat-out upshifts scored (Fabia, 208); the Fabia game-data best (7500, the limiter) checked by hand in the fabia report

aspects.name: Limiter held on a straight
aspects.description: Seconds per km held on the limiter (>= LIMITER_BAND of it, flat out, one gear below top) with nothing to ask for the revs: no change up within 1 s, no brake, gear change down or corner within 100 m or 3 s, no wheelspin, not a crawl. On loose surfaces the limiter between corners is often right; only the held-straight class counts. Per stage, a held-straight episode is a tip only when the reference run was at least 0.1 s quicker over the same road to the next braking, or in a higher gear there; a gear held on the limiter into the same corner in 3 of the last 5 runs for over a second is described once as gearing.

derivations.formula: Episodes of rows with rpm >= band x limiter, throttle >= 0.95, one gear below top (the game's count, else the shipped gear set's); each classed crawl (mean speed < 8 m/s), spin (slip_rpm > 0.15), up-down, shift, held-corner, held-straight (1.5 s or 80 m with none of those) or touch; limiter.held = seconds of held-straight / km.

outputs.name: limiter.held
outputs.note: held-straight episodes only; the located episodes of every class are in the events table

validation.evidence: replay of the 15 ACR and WRCG captures (60 runs, 1159 corners), 2026-10-05: 0 s/km held on every ACR run; 81 of the 122 limiter rows below top gear carry wheelspin

aspects.name: Top gear use (gearing)
aspects.description: Time on the limiter in top gear, share of time in top, peak revs in top: final drive too short or long.

derivations.formula: As limiter time, for gear == top; share of moving time in top; max rpm in top / limiter.

gates.conditions: >= 3 runs of the same stage on the tune (tuning.py)

validation.evidence: tests/test_coach.py, tests/test_tuning.py; WRCG capture

acr.note: the top gear is the shipped gear set's where the game sends no gear count

aspects.name: Launch quality
aspects.description: From a held launch: time to 50 km/h, the mean acceleration over the first half second (g), a bog judged by outcome (under 0.3 g, or 0.5 s over the median of the last launches on the surface), stall, and the seconds the revs sat on the limiter in the launch gear (a change up as the cut comes in is the technique). The game's own auto-clutch launch (the clutch never pressed while standing) neither bogs, nor is held, nor is the driver's; a game whose speed channel is unchecked (WRC Generations) has no launch coaching.

derivations.formula: Launch held >= 0.5 s; t50 = release delay + time to 50 km/h; g = mean a_long over the first 0.5 s in the launch gear; bog = g < 0.3 or t50 over the median + 0.5 s; stall from the revs in the launch gear in the first 2 s; cut = seconds in the launch gear (first 8 s) with the revs at 0.985 x the limiter or more; none when the run restarted within 10 s.

gates.conditions: the driver's own launch (the game's auto-clutch writes no bog or cut); not a game whose speed channel is unchecked

validation.evidence: replay of the 7 ACR captures (21 runs, 405 corners, 500 shifts), 2026-09-28: 20 launches

aspects.name: Section time loss
aspects.description: Seconds lost in the sections of the last run against the car's best finished clean run of the stage (corners less than 1.5 s apart joined, each section from where the reference's braking for it begins to where the next one's does; the first section, which holds the launch, is left out of the tips), named by call and distance, with what was done differently (braking point, minimum speed, exit speed, throttle) and the one thing to do; offs and a learning run left out. The metric is the three worst sections' sum. The best sections of all the car's runs put together are the stage's "possible" time.

derivations.formula: Time through the reference's section in this run minus the reference's own, split at this run's slowest point into entry and exit loss; worst three summed (the metric). At coach time: the section's pattern (over-slowing, under-committed, overdriven, late throttle, over-rotated, slower, the gravel entry that gained) from the braking point, minimum, exit speed and throttle-on time against the reference's matched section; the best time through each grid section over the car's runs gives the possible time.
derivations.module: oversteer/coach_context.py section_loss, section_report, stitched; oversteer/coach.py Coach._place_tips

gates.conditions: a finished clean or learning run of the same car and stage, in the same conditions

validation.evidence: replay of the 15 ACR and WRCG captures (60 runs, 1159 corners), 2026-10-05, step 2: the i20N's, Fabia's and 208's last Afon Bidno runs each name their costliest corners with cause (e.g. the 208's 2 right at 3.0 km, 2.4 s, 18 km/h slower); the start's section no longer reads a 38 s slow launch as a corner

aspects.name: Driven-wheel slip from the revs
aspects.description: Where a game sends no wheel speeds, the driven axle's slip from the revs: rpm / (speed x the game's ratio of the gear) - 1 less the gear's zero at partial throttle, valid with the gear held 0.3 s and the clutch up. Says wheelspin on the cut, at a launch and out of corners.

derivations.formula: slip_rpm per row; the zero of a gear is the median over its partial-throttle rows (switched off where it is further than 0.05 from nothing: the ratio is wrong); exit.spin = share of exits whose second after throttle-on ran over 0.15 on most rows.

validation.evidence: replay of the 15 ACR and WRCG captures (60 runs, 1159 corners), 2026-10-05: i20N partial-throttle median within +-0.05 in 3rd to 5th; the 208 and the Fabia off in the gears whose ratio disagrees
